purpose: Prevent cache/path heuristics from breaking installed applications or repositories while preserving low-friction storage decisions.

protected_generic_roots.future_orphan_handling: per-entry evidence may reach HUMAN_REVIEW only until an explicit orphan/serviceability contract is proven

to_protected: registered installed application whose install/uninstall/repair/update target intersects the candidate tree
broken or missing registered uninstaller/repair/update executable whose expected path intersects the candidate tree
to_human_review: clean reproducible clone whose removal still requires operator disposition
to_reclaim_proven: explicit adapter-backed regenerable cache with deterministic regeneration evidence
repository-generated/build artifact whose generating source and boundary are proven

entire_evidence.role: context accelerator and repo relationship/activity evidence; not deletion authority
graph_when_available: use working-tree graph queries for current code relationships/change impact
use --head comparison when committed baseline matters
treat Entire session/checkpoint evidence as activity context only
entire_evidence.legacy_rule: No repo/file is legacy from age, inactivity, or Entire absence alone. REPO_LEGACY_CANDIDATE requires clean/recoverable/no-active-worktree/no-current-dependency/no-unique-work evidence across canonical adapters.

application_rules.preferred_action: semantic owner action such as clean-cache/uninstall/repair before raw file deletion
application_rules.installed_application_intersection_rule: If uninstall/install/modify/repair/update metadata, service/task/shortcut/runtime evidence, or executable metadata binds an installed application to the candidate tree, raw file deletion is forbidden. Route to semantic application action.
application_rules.broken_registration_rule: If Windows reports the application installed but its registered uninstall/repair/update executable is missing, classify APP_INSTALLATION_BROKEN + APP_SERVICEABILITY_DEPENDENCY, protect the tree from raw deletion, and route to vendor/installer repair or semantic uninstall recovery.
required_windows_attribution_evidence: HKLM/HKCU uninstall entries in both registry views
running executable/module evidence when safely observable
semantic_actions_before_raw_delete: CLEAN_CACHE only for adapter-proven regenerable cache boundaries
REPAIR_APPLICATION for broken installed applications the operator wants to keep
UNINSTALL_APPLICATION through registered/vendor semantics when the operator wants removal

entire.unverified_named_capability: Mini must be discovered locally before use

operator_judgment_boundary.rule: Do not ask the operator to guess ownership, serviceability, regenerability, repository uniqueness, or other safely measurable technical facts. FileSteward must collapse app/repo/toolchain/shared dependency evidence into a clear classification before presenting choices.
